author: Adelaar, K. A.
title: Mise au point sur l'histoire linguistique du malais jakartanais
notes: Consulted directly on 25 November 2026 (Persée PDF in Downloads). A reply, in French, to Grijns (1991) and to Lombard's review of it: Jakarta Malay keeps the PAN schwa in closed final syllables (*qatep > atep, standard Malay atap) where other Malayic isolects have a, which Adelaar (1985/1992a, more than seven pages, fourteen words) takes as a retention from Proto-Malayic and Grijns as Javanese, Sundanese or Balinese influence. Banten letters of 1619 (Ricklefs 1976) already show such e (p. 49).
